title: Got to celebrate Pride Night at @heatedrivalryparody with a theater f...
transcript: Oh, hi. Welcome to my attic. One might argue that heated rivalry the unauthorized Musical parody celebrates pride every single night. But this weekend is their official pride Celebration, and obviously, Tyler and I were not gonna miss it. Now, this was my third time seeing Heated Rivalry the Unauthorized Musical Parody, and there's a reason I keep coming back, and that's because it's so good. Everyone who works on this show clearly loves Shane and Ilya. They understand why so many people connect with these characters and the story, and then they use that love to turn it into one of the funniest, dirtiest musicals I've ever seen. The music is so catchy and you won't stop laughing. Ginger ale cold enough? Ginger ale is always cold enough here. And for their pride weekend, they're giving back. They've partnered with Today Ticks to give 10% of ticket sales to NYC Pride. They have cool activations and photo ops. I'm coming to the cottage! And exclusive today takes giveaways. Plus, if you're going to the three PM performance on Sunday, June 21st, there's a talk back after the show and a pride after party. So if you haven't seen it yet, or if you have, now is a great time to visit your favorite hockey boys. And they've made it even easier to get to the cottage because they just announced a digital rush today. So grab your ginger ale or your favourite blueberry banana smoothie. Celebrate pride with a little Musical reheat and prepare to laugh so hard that your face will literally hurt. And keep an eye out next week at the New York Pride Parade because the heated rivalry and authorised musical parody will have its own float and these loons are very excited about it. Happy pride!
showTitle: Heated Rivalry: The Unauthorized Musical Parody
classificationReason: Creator is attending for the third time and shares clear opinions ('so good', 'funniest, dirtiest musicals I've ever seen', 'music is so catchy') with a recommendation.
